statement: Discoverability/eligibility for a principal-to-agent relationship ("is this agent admitted and bound to this principal at all") MUST be derived from a durable, multi-membership STRUCTURAL store (e.g. an assignment/roster table with no cardinality limit per principal). It MUST NEVER be derived from a single-slot LIVE AUTHORITY store (e.g. a current-delegation/current-session/active-grant table intentionally limited to one active row per principal), because doing so makes eligibility for every OTHER structurally-admitted relationship flicker based on whichever one relationship currently occupies that single slot. The live-authority store remains the correct and ONLY source for a later, per-action authority/mandate decision — the two questions are answered by two different mechanisms, never one.
classification: A structural/governance-boundary confusion: a single-cardinality live-control mechanism was reused to answer a multi-cardinality structural-membership question, because both mechanisms happened to expose a similarly-shaped 'is X currently true for (principal, target)' boolean. The two are only superficially similar signatures over genuinely different domains (durable structural fact vs. transient exclusive control).

canaries.assertion: A structurally assigned consumer with NO current delegation grant is still ELIGIBLE for every Financial Service; discovery's Runtime authority prerequisite reads PENDING (non-blocking) rather than the service being marked ineligible.

occurrences.defect: Financial Services eligibility/discovery required `readActiveGrant(personaId)` (delegation_grants, deliberately capped at one active grant per persona) to return a grant matching the exact target agent — so a persona managing several structurally assigned agents could only ever have ONE agent read as eligible at a time, with eligibility flickering based on which agent's grant happened to be currently active rather than on durable admission/assignment facts.

notes: This is a specialization of `inv.engineering.036`/`037` (one authoritative location per concern; a parallel implementation is a defect) applied to a subtler case: not a duplicated implementation, but ONE implementation reused across two concerns it was never designed to serve simultaneously.

The generic shape to watch for elsewhere in this codebase: any 'is currently active' store whose write path explicitly supersedes/replaces a prior row for the same principal (grants, sessions, active-assignment-of-one-kind fields) is a LIVE-AUTHORITY store by construction, and is the wrong source for a multi-membership eligibility/roster question, however convenient its boolean-shaped read looks at a single call site.
